schema.title: Response List Sources Api Datasources Get
Response List Templates Api Query Templates Get
Response Admin List Templates Api Admin Query Templates Get
Response Admin Template History Api Admin Query Templates  Template Id  History Get
Response Admin Audit Api Admin Audit Get

scale.description: How to read the score, e.g. 'z-score', 'isolation-forest 0..1'
scale.title: Scale

type.description: Type as reported by the database driver
type.title: Type

drive_chain_id.description: Components sharing a drive chain (scenario S19) share this id
drive_chain_id.title: Drive Chain Id

ComponentLifecycle.description: One physical installation of a component. Replacement creates a new lifecycle (L3-06).
ComponentLifecycle.title: ComponentLifecycle

DataSourceConfig.description:
Connection configuration as exposed through the API.

Credentials are never part of this schema (SEC-03): ``credential_ref`` names a server-side secret.
DataSourceConfig.title: DataSourceConfig

EligibilityCondition.description: A declarative precondition checked before the operator's output may be used (L6-01).
EligibilityCondition.title: EligibilityCondition

result_ref.description: Id of the underlying result (prediction, rule hit, report)
result_ref.title: Result Ref

FailureProbabilityResult.description: Only valid when genuine failure/lifecycle evidence exists (L5-05).
FailureProbabilityResult.title: FailureProbabilityResult

HealthState.description: Prediction output (L6-04). Never used as a self-generated training label.
HealthState.title: HealthState

LocalizedText.description: User-facing text in both supported languages (GEN-05).
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

MaintenanceEvent.description: An intervention event (L3-05). Lubrication never resets aging (L3-08).
MaintenanceEvent.title: MaintenanceEvent

OperatingRegime.description: Observable operating conditions used for normalization and eligibility (L3-03).
OperatingRegime.title: OperatingRegime

OperatingState.description: Machine/component operating state (L3-02). Not a health state.
OperatingState.title: OperatingState

truncated.description: True when more rows existed than the row limit allowed
truncated.title: Truncated

QueryTemplate.description: An approved, parameterized, read-only query (L1-05). SQL text is visible to admins only.
QueryTemplate.title: QueryTemplate

QueryTemplateAdminView.description: Template including its SQL text; returned to administrators only.
QueryTemplateAdminView.title: QueryTemplateAdminView

QueryTemplateSpec.description: What an administrator submits to create or change a template (L1-05). Versions are assigned.
QueryTemplateSpec.title: QueryTemplateSpec

RawTelemetryRow.description: One row as returned by the source, before semantic mapping (ARCHITECTURE §4 layer 1).

source_ref.description: Data source id plus template/version that produced the row
source_ref.title: Source Ref

RawTelemetryRow.title: RawTelemetryRow

ResultMeta.description:
Provenance carried by every analytical result (GEN-06, GEN-03).

Versions are opaque strings such as ``"ewma-torque@1.2.0"``. ``None`` is not allowed: a component
that does not use a model still reports which rule or operator version produced the result.
ResultMeta.title: ResultMeta

SignalConfigVersion.description: Immutable snapshot reference for the signal configuration (L2-05).
SignalConfigVersion.title: SignalConfigVersion

unit.description: Engineering unit of normalized values, e.g. 'rpm', 'N*m', 's'
unit.title: Unit

SignalMapping.description: Binds a logical signal to a device + KeyName in a data source (L2-01).
SignalMapping.title: SignalMapping

SourceSchema.description: Read-only structural discovery: schemas, tables, columns (L1-04).

engine.description: Engine reported by the live connection, e.g. 'postgresql'
engine.title: Engine

SourceSchema.title: SourceSchema

SqlTableLayout.description:
Where telemetry lives in a SQL source. Configured per source, never assumed (L1-08).

``value_columns`` are read in order and the first non-null one is the value, which covers
sources that split values by type (e.g. ``value_double`` and ``value_long``).

naive_time_zone.description: Zone for timestamp columns without time zone; verify against the source
naive_time_zone.title: Naive Time Zone

verified.description: True only after the layout was checked against the real database
verified.title: Verified

SqlTableLayout.title: SqlTableLayout

TimeWindow.description: Half-open interval [start, end) in timezone-aware timestamps.
TimeWindow.title: TimeWindow

VisualizationSeries.description: Downsampled data for charts only; never an algorithm input (L2-06).
VisualizationSeries.title: VisualizationSeries
